reviewKind: Independent incremental working-source advisory; not task approval
disposition: The inherited Cargo output-path assumption identified in review 01 is now fail-closed in the helper. No new blocking finding in the incremental correction.

checks.scope: Eight prior regressions plus missing-artifact and alternate-output rejection. Real product validator and synthetic files; Cargo, Git inventory, tool environment and PE verifier remain declared doubles.

incrementalAssessment: The actual Cargo invocation requests JSON messages. After the existing source/renderer interval validation, the helper requires exactly one compiler-artifact for target project_contract_probe of kind example.

The reported executable must exactly equal the expected debug/release probe path before PE validation or executable hashing; an older binary at the expected path cannot supply a passing record when Cargo reports a different output or no matching artifact.

Missing or duplicate matching events, wrong target identity/kind, malformed messages and unequal paths cannot satisfy the new check. The implementation has no permissive fallback to the old assumed path.
The missing-artifact and alternate-output regressions both assert that PE verification is never reached. All prior manifest/source/artifact race regressions still pass.
The correction changes the verification helper and its tests only; no production authority or controller is introduced.
remainingLimits: These tests do not establish real Cargo message compatibility or real debug/release PE results; root's separate actual-build records are required.
Interval endpoint hashes are not an atomic build snapshot against hostile same-account change-and-restore writes, and this advisory does not establish final executable publication atomicity.
This increment does not reclassify or independently replay prior native UI observations and is not final commit-bound task approval.
mutations: This append-only advisory record only; no production edit, native build, UI action, Git mutation or task transition.
